# Cuetopia Billiard Cafe

> Pool, foosball and darts on Almaden Expy in San Jose. Chicago Style hot dogs, a huge beer selection and room for company parties. Open daily.

## About
Cuetopia Billiard Cafe is San Jose's place to play pool, billiards, foosball and darts. We're on Almaden Expy, open every evening and into the early morning.
Hungry? Grab one of our Signature Hot Dogs, Chicago Style or Polish Dog, steamed in beer on buns baked fresh from Roma Bakery. Wash it down with something from our huge beer selection, or go with a coffee or espresso from Uncommon Grounds.
Planning a company party? We've got a large room for rent. Come see why we're rated 4.3 on Google from 389 reviews.

## Services
- Pool and billiards: Over 25 pool tables, so there's usually room to rack up.
- Foosball and darts: Take a break from the felt and play a round of foosball or darts.
- Arcade: Arcade-style games right at the entrance.
- Signature Hot Dogs: Chicago Style and Polish Dog, steamed in beer, on buns baked fresh from Roma Bakery.
- Beer: A huge beer selection, over 50 beers.
- Gourmet Coffees & Espresso: Coffee and espresso from Uncommon Grounds.
- Company parties and corporate events: A large room for rent with 12 tables for your group.

## FAQ
Q: When are you open?
A: Every day from 5:00 PM to 2:00 AM. Call to confirm on holidays.

Q: How much is table time?
A: Pool tables are rented by the hour. Give us a call to confirm current prices.

Q: Can we book a room for a company party?
A: Yes. We have a large room for rent with 12 tables, good for company parties and corporate events.

Q: Is there parking?
A: One reviewer mentioned there's plenty of parking.

## What customers say
- "Great experience, love the family atmosphere while being able to offer adult fun if wanted. My 12 year enjoyed the arcade at the entrance before shooting a few games of pool with some nachos and candy table side" (Amanda Perez, 5/5)

- "Very happy to find this pool hall as they are a dying breed. Great place to play pool. Very roomy with a lot of tables and reasonable prices. And their beer is super cold! One complaint is the cue sticks need the tips replaced. Other than that, a great place to hang out and play some pool. Will definitely be coming back :)" (Maria K., 4/5)
- "A great place to play pool. They have plenty of tables and they play music and have beer on tap." (S. Devlin, 4/5)
